scripts.test:wasm: crates/wasm/build-wasm.sh && bun run build:wasm:dist && bash -c 'n=$(ls packages/webtransport/test/wasm-*.test.ts | wc -l | tr -d " "); test "$n" -ge 14 || { echo "expected ≥14 wasm-*.test.ts, found $n" >&2; exit 1; }' && WEBTRANSPORT_REQUIRE_WASM=1 WEBTRANSPORT_REQUIRE_WASM_DIST=1 bun test packages/webtransport/test/wasm-0rtt.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-abuse.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-bun-udp.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-cert.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-datagram-echo.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-dist-behavioral.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-facade-options.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-facade.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-limits.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-multi-session.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-qpack-options.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-security-close.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/wasm-stream-echo.test.ts packages/webtransport/test/webtransport-like.test.ts
scripts.test:wasm:interop: crates/wasm/build-wasm.sh && bun run build:native && WEBTRANSPORT_REQUIRE_WASM=1 bun test packages/webtransport/test/wasm-native-interop.test.ts
scripts.example:echo:cert: mkdir -p examples/echo-playground/certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 -days 10 -nodes -keyout examples/echo-playground/certs/key.pem -out examples/echo-playground/certs/cert.pem -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName = DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1'
scripts.test:interop:wasm-server: bun run build:wasm && cd tools/interop && bunx playwright test -c playwright.wasm.config.ts
scripts.release:npm: node -e "console.error('Direct npm publishing is disabled. Use the GitHub Actions publish workflow from a successful release run.'); process.exit(1)"
